config.book_seed: the book's seed picks holdings among the survivors and never enters the screen the scores are read from

stop_rule.wording: the stop rule written before the read is not triggered: this permits V2-P7-006 to proceed and is not evidence

power_if_planning_sd_were_this.wording: if the planning sd were this value measured in the one reading of this window: an observed value of that reading, never a planning value by itself

wording: the one pre-registered read of this window: a first out-of-sample reading, not confirmatory evidence; confirmatory evidence comes only from forward records registered under V2-P7-006
every score is a candidate research signal (候选), never a verdict
